## Tattoo Services

- [Custom Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/custom-tattoos/): Original tattoo concepts, placement and sizing guidance.
- [Name Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/name-tattoos/): Personal lettering and name tattoo planning.
- [Fine Line Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/fine-line-tattoos/): Fine line tattoo design, sizing and placement.
- [Black & Grey Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/black-grey-tattoos/): Black and grey tattoo work and shading.
- [Colour Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/colour-tattoos/): Colour tattoo planning and palette guidance.
- [Portrait Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/portrait-tattoos/): Portrait and realism tattoo planning.
- [Religious Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/religious-tattoos/): Religious and devotional tattoo designs.
- [Cover Up Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/cover-up-tattoos/): Assessment and planning to cover existing tattoos.
- [Sleeve Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/sleeve-tattoos/): Full-arm tattoo composition and session planning.
- [Minimal Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/minimal-tattoos/): Minimal tattoo designs and placement.
- [Temporary Tattoos](https://divineinktattoos.in/services/temporary-tattoos/): Temporary tattoo options.

## Service and Appointment Information

- Tattoo consultations consider the design reference, body placement, practical size and level of detail.
- Cover-up feasibility depends on the existing tattoo's size, darkness, position and skin condition.
- Piercing placement is assessed for individual anatomy before the procedure.
- Customers should contact the studio to confirm current pricing, appointment availability and service details before visiting.
